definition_en: A domestic fowl kept for its eggs or meat, especially the flesh eaten as food.
examples: Roast chicken seasoned with rosemary makes a classic Sunday dinner.
Skinless chicken breasts provide lean protein for athletes.

definition_en: The flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food
definition_zh: n. 肉, 餐, 食物
examples: Fresh meat can be incorporated into a wide variety of delicious recipes.

definition_en: N the flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food
examples: Fresh meats can be incorporated into a wide variety of delicious recipes.

definition_en: The flesh of a cow, bull, or ox, used as food.
examples: Slow-simmered beef stew fills the kitchen with savory warmth.
Wagyu beef is renowned worldwide for exquisite marbling.

definition_en: The flesh of a pig used as food, especially when uncured.
examples: Braised pork belly is a cornerstone of Chinese home-style gastronomy.
Glaze tender pork tenderloin with apple cider and mustard.

definition_en: Highly seasoned minced meat stuffed in casings
examples: Fresh sausage can be incorporated into a wide variety of delicious recipes.

definition_en: Edible fish (broadly including freshwater fish) or shellfish or roe etc
definition_zh: n. 海味, 海鲜, 鱼类
examples: Fresh seafood can be incorporated into a wide variety of delicious recipes.

definition_en: A slice of meat cut from the fleshy part of an animal or large fish
definition_zh: n. 牛排, 鱼排, 肉排
examples: Fresh steak can be incorporated into a wide variety of delicious recipes.

definition_en: Back and sides of a hog salted and dried or smoked; usually sliced thin and fried
examples: Fresh bacon can be incorporated into a wide variety of delicious recipes.

definition_en: The meat of a young sheep eaten as food.
examples: Herb-crusted rack of lamb is a customary centerpiece for festive banquets.
Marinate lamb skewers with cumin and coriander before charcoal grilling.

definition_en: A large edible fish with pink flesh, celebrated for rich omega-3 fatty acids.
examples: Pan-sear wild Atlantic salmon skin-side down until wonderfully crispy.
Smoked salmon and cream cheese are beloved bagel toppings.

definition_en: A small free-swimming crustacean with an elongated body, highly prized as seafood.
examples: Garlic butter shrimp sautéed with parsley cooks in under four minutes.
The coastal town hosts an annual festival celebrating freshly caught shrimp.

definition_en: A large predatory oceanic fish of the mackerel family, heavily fished commercially.
examples: Seared yellowfin tuna coated in black sesame is a delicacy.

definition_en: Burrowing marine mollusk living on sand or mud; the shell closes with viselike firmness
definition_zh: n. 蛤, 沉默寡言的人
examples: Fresh clam can be incorporated into a wide variety of delicious recipes.

definition_en: Decapod having eyes on short stalks and a broad flattened carapace with a small abdomen folded under the thorax and pincers
definition_zh: n. 螃蟹, 偏航, 脾气乖戾的人, 沙果
examples: Fresh crab can be incorporated into a wide variety of delicious recipes.

definition_en: N meat from a mature domestic sheep
examples: Fresh mutton can be incorporated into a wide variety of delicious recipes.

definition_en: Any of various edible decapod crustaceans
examples: Fresh prawn can be incorporated into a wide variety of delicious recipes.
